title: Fix pre-existing kramdown-rfc/xml2rfc build warnings
description: Warnings from a full rebuild on 2026-10-31 (kramdown-rfc 1.7.43, xml2rfc 3.33.0). All predate commit c08568e; none were introduced by the BCP14 sweep. Build: KRAMDOWN_REFCACHEDIR=.refcache kramdown-rfc X.md > X.xml && xml2rfc --text --html X.xml (run without -q to see warnings).
